knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Quarantine is required until history and specialist direction are known.
A claim is relied on only after it has been validated.

practicalCriteria: The learner completes an equipment-eligibility register for fictional assets, with a status for each. Pass: every asset has a status and a basis.
The learner identifies a decontamination claim that needs validation and states what evidence would validate it. Pass: the claim is marked unvalidated and the evidence is named.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
